metric_definitions.R: Per-clip reward sum/(0.1*full_reference_steps), arithmetic mean over clips; failed suffix scores zero.
metric_definitions.C: Per-clip executed/full-reference steps, then equal-clip mean; distinct from completed-clip fraction.
metric_definitions.errors: Errors use each clip's executed steps; common-complete sets are conditional comparisons.
metric_definitions.bin_errors: All k8 state errors assigned to sampled window start's50-frame bin. Error sums are populated for flip/handstand only; other hard rows have count data but absent error measurements.
metric_definitions.own_replay: Per-bin and source WM errors use each branch's evolving replay and are not same-input model comparisons.
metric_definitions.gap: R+1-C assumes only missing suffixes are filled perfectly without changing already executed trajectories, not a future policy bound.

causal_boundaries: Velocity-height does not show overall control/real fixed-window accuracy benefit at this budget, but does retain446 more complete clips and higher three-node coverage intersection; it is not uniformly inferior in every metric or node.
Candidate endpoint body-orientation contribution and joint RMSE improve relative to control. The main R losses instead involve root position, body linear/angular velocity and root orientation.

Residual control LAFAN loss occurs despite no new root-height structural intervention; candidate is not the sole cause of ongoing retention instability. Candidate has higher three-node mean LAFAN R and common success despite lower endpoint R.

All eligible50-frame k8-start bins are visited. Absence of entire eligible bins is not supported as the remaining critical-phase explanation. This does not prove each exact state/action neighborhood or phase is accurately learned.
Candidate low own-replay k8 z error and nearlyzero kinematic residual do not imply long-rollout accuracy; own-replay velocity/rotation tradeoffs and paired fixed-window errors must be kept distinct.
Height construction is one rejected approach at this fixed budget, not proof that all kinematic structure or longer WM learning is ineffective.
Existing LAFAN>=.82 success remains accepted; no extra seeds or new acceptance thresholds are imposed.

p12_recommendation.decision: Long-alive same-input prediction accuracy plus real hard control, all/other quality and LAFAN retention; report tradeoffs and fixed-budget negative results without automatic extension.
